catalog: COSMOSWeb_mastercatalog_v1.1.fits, not Zhen-Kai v13 F444W-detection catalog

flags.warn_flag_0: Most secure COSMOS2025 sources; not necessarily appropriate for deliberately one-band dropout selection.
flags.warn_flag_4: Single NIRCam detection: significant detection in one NIRCam band, other NIRCam+HST+MIRI bands have magnitude errors >0.5 mag or are not detected; explicitly classified as potential imaging artifact.
flags.warn_flag_1: Hot pixel; potentially relevant independent quality check.
flags.warn_flag_5: Unrealistically small source radius; potentially relevant.
flags.warn_flag_6: Small aperture flux ratio, below stated PSF consistency threshold; potentially relevant.
flags.flag_star: Official catalog describes source-pixel overlap with JWST/NIRCam starmask; center-pixel outside mask does not imply source-pixel overlap zero. Official wording about '0-80 percent' is ambiguous, do not invent precise threshold.
flags.flag_blend: Kron aperture correction >3; indicates F444W blending, source-level rather than sky-area flag.

calculation.note: F444W-only selection with SNR>5 overlaps this flag regime when F444W SNR>~5.43 and the required non-detections in other bands are met. Other catalog-specific conditions still apply.

science_implication: Do not impose COSMOS2025 warn_flag==0 indiscriminately on F444W-only brown-dwarf candidates; it can remove the exact population being sought. Investigate artifact contamination via independent pixel/PSF morphology, bad-pixel, source overlap and multi-epoch consistency instead. Do not assume Zhen-Kai v13 use_phot or Dave selection is equivalent to COSMOS2025 warn_flag.
code1_semantics: The official webpage confirms JWST starmask use in flag_star but does not explicitly document FITS binary value 1=masked; retain code1 interpretation as conditional.
